apps.name: Webink
apps.subtitle: Discover, read, and sync manga across devices
apps.localizedDescription:
Webink is a manga reading app designed for manga enthusiasts to discover, read, and organize their favorite titles from multiple sources. Stay updated with the latest releases and trending manga directly on the home page. The app offers a powerful search feature, allowing users to search for manga across different sources or within their own saved library.

Save your favorite manga to your library and track your reading progress easily. For users who prefer to sync their library across devices, Webink provides seamless integration with Google, allowing library synchronisation.
